subject: P1 external-memory path audit — explicit call sites absent, policy gap remediated on integration branch
summary: Repository search on the base revision found no explicit chatgpt_memory/saved_memory/memory_recall/native_memory call sites. Existing bootstrap, scheduler, handoff and synchronization architecture is already external-state oriented. The confirmed defect was therefore a missing explicit machine-readable deny boundary at the host/model persistence layer, not a discovered Python native-memory API call. Branch p1-external-memory-layered-context-20261007 now adds IEP-MEM-001, runtime guard, tests, build validation, forensic records and fresh-agent bootstrap enforcement. IEP-CTX-001 is explicitly constrained so layered context awareness cannot elevate native ChatGPT memory into swarm authority.
